name: Microsoft Cost Management
short_description: Microsoft's suite of FinOps tools to analyze, monitor and optimize cloud costs, with cost analysis, budgets, alerts and exports; also known as Azure Cost Management.

evidence.quote: Azure Cost Management can help teams examine supported cost
